rows.label: How chosen
rows.b: Elected by state MLAs through single transferable vote

rows.label: Term
rows.b: Permanent; one-third of members retire every two years

rows.label: Money Bill
rows.b: Can only recommend changes within 14 days

rows.label: Council of Ministers
rows.a: Collectively responsible to it; can pass no-confidence

en.takeaway: The government answers to the Lok Sabha alone; the Rajya Sabha represents the states and gives Parliament continuity.

hi.takeaway: सरकार केवल लोकसभा के प्रति उत्तरदायी है; राज्यसभा राज्यों का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है और संसद को निरंतरता देती है।
